## Scope

List affected package names or application paths, including shared tooling when relevant.

## Changes

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any breaking changes. Link related issues if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.
For UI changes, include before/after screenshots and the themes, modes or viewport sizes checked.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the behavior change, where applicable.
- [ ] Generated files are updated if their sources changed.
- [ ] A changeset is included for changes that affect published packages, or is not needed.
